app.name: Shared Board
app.description: A revisioned board whose human form and WebMCP tools use the same operations.

tools.name: inspect_board
tools.title: Inspect board
tools.description: Read every item, the item count, and revision from the board visible in the open page. Does not modify the board.

preconditions: The Shared Board document is active.
successEvidence: The result contains board ID, items, item count, and revision.

tools.name: add_board_item
tools.title: Add board item
tools.description: Add one titled item through the canonical board operation when the supplied revision is current. Returns the committed item and new revision.

title.description: Visible title for the new board item.

expectedRevision.description: Board revision observed immediately before the add operation.

preconditions: The Shared Board document is active.
expectedRevision matches the current board revision.
semantics.visibleEffect: The board list, count, revision, and activity record display the committed item.
successEvidence: The result identifies the added item and committed revision.
The visible board contains the returned item at the returned revision.
failureModes: The title is empty or too long.
The board revision changed before commit.
